title: 4 Missed Sell Bugs — Bot held positions through full reversals

context.trigger: User reported wallet 0x5067551a2b95710a9acba9623e92fb03c08ea656 as example of missed sell. Bot was holding positions through complete reversals, surrendering all unrealized gains.
context.impact: Multiple positions peaked at 30-50%+ gain, reversed to hard stop at -20%, net loss on what should have been winning trades. User: 'you've cost me a ton of money'.

bugs_found.name: No trailing stop before TP1
bugs_found.root_cause: Trailing stop gated on tp1_hit=True. TP1 at 1.5x (50% gain). If position peaks at +40% and never triggers TP1, trailing stop NEVER activates. Only exit is hard stop at -20%.
bugs_found.scenario: Buy $1.00 → peak $1.40 (+40%) → falls to $0.80 (-20%) → hard stop. All $0.40 gain surrendered.
bugs_found.fix: Added PRE_TP1_TRAILING_STOP_PCT=25% that activates when up >15%, before TP1 is hit.

bugs_found.name: Confluence gate permanently blocking profitable exits
bugs_found.root_cause: The 2-of-5 bearish signal gate depended on stored fields (entry_volume_1h, buy_pressure_ratio, entry_liquidity_usd) that are absent from most positions. Missing data → bearish_count stays 0 → sell PERMANENTLY BLOCKED for profitable positions >20% gain.
bugs_found.fix: Lowered to 1-of-5. Added hard reversal override (CONFLUENCE_HARD_REVERSAL_PCT=25%): if price drops >25% from peak on a profitable position, bypass all signal checks and sell immediately.

bugs_found.name: God Mode never activates trailing stop
bugs_found.root_cause: God Mode skips TP1 sell without setting pos['tp1_hit']=True. Trailing stop code gates on tp1_hit. God Mode positions could reverse from any height all the way down to the -20% hard stop with zero protection.
bugs_found.fix: Now sets pos['tp1_hit']=True when God Mode skips TP1 sell, activating the trailing stop.

bugs_found.name: Live sell failures silently swallowed
bugs_found.root_cause: When a live sell fails (e.g., slippage exceeded, RPC error), the exception is swallowed. Position stays open. No retry, no alert. Bot continues monitoring and may re-evaluate next cycle but position is held at a loss.
bugs_found.fix: Track sell_failure_count. After 3 failures: CRITICAL log + Slack alert + set force_max_slippage flag.

also_fixed_this_session.name: Missing return in calculate_offensive_position_size
also_fixed_this_session.root_cause: Function fell off the end without return statement. Python returned None. Caller at main.py:1021 tried to unpack (final_position_usd, sizing_reason) = None → TypeError: cannot unpack non-iterable NoneType object. This crashed every trade execution cycle.
also_fixed_this_session.method: Found via AST cross-reference: identified a 2-tuple unpack at call site, traced to function definition, found no return statement in the code.

lessons: NEVER gate the trailing stop exclusively on tp1_hit. Always have a pre-TP1 peak protection layer.
Confluence gates that depend on stored data fields are unreliable — those fields are often not populated. Always have a hard override based on price action alone.
When a mode (God Mode, etc.) skips a sell action, check if that action was supposed to set a state flag (tp1_hit). Skipping the sell must not prevent the flag from being set.
Missing return statements in functions that return tuples are hard to detect because Python returns None silently. The TypeError only shows up at the call site, obscuring the real location.
Always add Slack escalation for failed live sells — silent failures are invisible in production.
